$comment: Advisories reviewed and accepted, each with a reason and a date to look again. Checked by scripts/audit-check.mjs; anything not listed here at high or above fails the build.

advisories.reason: Pulled in by the Prisma CLI (a dev tool) for its MySQL driver. This app talks to PostgreSQL only; mysql2 is never loaded at build time or at runtime. Fixed upstream in Prisma 8, which is not yet adopted.
Used by @prisma/config to merge the CLI's configuration file, on the developer's machine only. Never runs on the server. Fixed upstream in Prisma 8, which is not yet adopted.
